summary: tempfile creates temporary files or directories portably (avoiding mktemp differences); they're only accessible by the creator, and prefix/suffix must not contain path separators.
questions: How do I create a temp directory on a remote host?
Who can access files made by tempfile?
How do I create temp files on Windows?

answer_card.title: Create temporary files and directories
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.tempfile` creates temp files/dirs portably. They're **only accessible by the creator**; use `file` to change permissions. `prefix`/`suffix` can't contain `/`. Windows: `ansible.windows.win_tempfile`.
